Also: kit.toml [project] worktrees, ALIX's bin/wt (read only)
failing_case: A temporary project whose bin/wt makes .worktree/<task>: relay's guard treats a session in .worktree/x as the main checkout (or refuses its work).
pass_cases: The same session is treated as a task worktree; a project using .worktrees is unchanged.

details: CONFIRMED by probe. git marks an entry prunable only when it is not locked, so the filter `not w["prunable"]` misses a
locked entry whose folder is gone. relay itself locks worktrees (merge.py:92) when a merged branch's worktree holds the
running session, so locked entries are ordinary; a folder removed by hand afterwards reproduces the F2 failure of the
design review, which the brief made a case of this change. Size: 5.
failing_case: Repo m, no kit.toml (ALIX shape). git worktree add .worktree/b -b wt/b; git worktree lock .worktree/b (relay's merge hook
does this: merge.py:92 "locked until this session ends"); rm -rf .worktree/b. git worktree list --porcelain prints the
entry with "locked" and no "prunable" line. Write {file_path: m/.worktree/b/x.ex} from an agent: exit 0 now, the file is
created in the main checkout's folder on no branch. Expected: exit 2, "writes to the main checkout", as for the
unlocked prunable case the change already refuses.
fix_hint: In listed_worktrees also drop entries whose folder is not a directory: `... and not w["prunable"] and os.path.isdir(w["path"])`
(one stat per entry, no git call). Add the locked-and-deleted row to test_a_removed_but_registered_worktree_is_not_a_task_worktree.
pass_cases: 1. Locked worktree .worktree/b, folder deleted: Write m/.worktree/b/x.ex -> exit 2.
2. Unlocked registered .worktree/gone, folder deleted (prunable): Write m/.worktree/gone/x.ex -> exit 2 (as today).
3. Locked live worktree .worktree/c (folder present): Write m/.worktree/c/x.ex -> exit 0.
reason: tests/test_hook_guard_main.py:374 passes, encodes locked deleted worktree refused and live locked allowed; fails at 1ff7198d.
findings.summary: a locked worktree whose folder was deleted is not marked prunable by git, so it stays exempt and a write there lands in the main checkout
